about-intro:
Software Developer with 3+ years of experience across mobile and full-stack.
I ship production apps with Flutter, React Native, Swift, and Kotlin — from payment gateways and POS systems to AI-powered chat products built on LLMs (OpenAI, Ollama) — published on both the App Store and Google Play.
On the web side I build PHP applications and WordPress platforms, and I maintain 15+ open-source Flutter packages on pub.dev.
about-tagline: Software Developer — mobile apps with Flutter, Swift & Kotlin, full-stack web with PHP & WordPress, and AI-powered products.
